controls.label: Hang spread
controls.persistenceMeaning: Normalized horizontal anchor span per upper rail.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes pivotX, local anchor spacing, derived frame-width cap, and swing headroom; source order and rail assignment remain fixed.
controls.causalTest: 45 and 95 must change pivot positions and dimensions while preserving IDs and empty collision list.

controls.label: Length variance
controls.persistenceMeaning: Deterministic variance around row-specific wire-length baselines.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes fullLength, periodScale, settled y, and arc envelope; pivot and source identity do not change.
controls.causalTest: At settled time, 0 and 70 must yield different length vectors and no collisions.

controls.label: Impulse strength
controls.persistenceMeaning: Shared requested angular amplitude before spacing safety clamp.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes damped angle during impulse/settle only; pivots, lengths, frame size, source pixels, and seam remain fixed.
controls.causalTest: At t=0.37, 0 must produce zero angle and 65 must produce non-zero bounded angle.

controls.label: Damping
controls.persistenceMeaning: Exponential loss-rate mapping for the shared pendulum impulse.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes angle envelope decay; period, pivot, length, route, and source pixels remain unchanged.
controls.causalTest: At late settle with equal impulse, 92 must yield lower maximum absolute angle than 35.

controls.label: Focus lift
controls.persistenceMeaning: Maximum selected-frame wire shortening and angular restraint.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes selected currentLength and angle restraint only; fullLength, pivot, source pixels, and non-selected frames remain equal.
controls.causalTest: At a focus peak, 50 must shorten/restrain selected frame more than 0 without changing neighbours.
